card.name: Type 1 diabetes, ketoacidosis, epinephrine endings
card.fires_on: The numeral 1 or I in "type 1 diabetes", the ending of "ketoacidosis", and the ending "rine" of epinephrine. It fires in warnings about diabetes drugs and allergic reactions.

modes.label: Type 1 diabetes
modes.description: The 1 or I after "type" in statements that a drug is not for type 1 diabetes.
modes.example: not indicated for glycemic control in patients with type <<1>> diabetes mellitus.

modes.label: Ketoacidosis ending
modes.description: The last piece of "ketoacidosis" when the drug should be stopped if it is suspected.
modes.example: discontinue GLYXAMBI if ketoacid<<osis>> is suspected.

modes.label: Epinephrine ending
modes.description: The final piece of "epinephrine" in anaphylaxis treatment text.
modes.example: Serious anaphylactic reactions require immediate emergency treatment with epineph<<rine>> and other resuscitation measures

card.plain: It marks the end of a few specific medical terms: type 1 diabetes, ketoacidosis and epinephrine.
